name: SETUP AFTER IMPORT
info:
1. Open the config node named “ContinIo MySQL — SET PASSWORD”.
2. Enter MySQL username root and your password.
3. Deploy.
4. Open http://localhost:1880/dashboard/admin

API:
POST /continio-api/wave-result
{session_id, student_id, wave_number, result, confidence}

POST /continio-api/finalize-session
{session_id}

GET /continio-api/health

For production, configure HTTPS and authentication in Node-RED settings.js. Do not expose port 1880 directly to the internet.

topic: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS continio_accounts (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, role ENUM('admin','teacher') NOT NULL, teacher_id INT NULL, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, email VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL UNIQUE, mobile VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, password_salt CHAR(32) NOT NULL, password_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL, active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (teacher_id) REFERENCES teachers(id) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE)

name: Validate registration
Build secure account
Registration success
func: msg.statusCode=201;msg.payload={ok:true,message:'Registration successful. You can now log in.'};return msg;

name: Rate limit and verify login
func: const p=msg.payload||{}, email=String(p.email||'').trim().toLowerCase(), ip=(msg.req&&msg.req.ip)||'local';let attempts=flow.get('loginAttempts')||{};let a=attempts[ip]||{count:0,until:0};if(a.until>Date.now()){msg.statusCode=429;msg.payload={error:'Too many attempts. Try again later.'};return [null,msg];}msg.loginIp=ip;msg.loginPassword=String(p.password||'');msg.topic="SELECT id,role,teacher_id,name,email,mobile,active,password_hash=SHA2(CONCAT(?,password_salt),256) AS password_ok FROM continio_accounts WHERE email=? LIMIT 1";msg.payload=[msg.loginPassword,email];return [msg,null];

name: Create secure session
func: const row=Array.isArray(msg.payload)?msg.payload[0]:null, ip=msg.loginIp;let attempts=flow.get('loginAttempts')||{};if(!row||!row.active||Number(row.password_ok)!==1){let a=attempts[ip]||{count:0,until:0};a.count++;if(a.count>=5){a.until=Date.now()+15*60*1000;a.count=0;}attempts[ip]=a;flow.set('loginAttempts',attempts);msg.statusCode=401;msg.payload={error:'Invalid email or password'};return msg;}delete attempts[ip];flow.set('loginAttempts',attempts);const token=[msg._msgid,Date.now().toString(36),Math.random().toString(36).slice(2),Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)].join('.');let sessions=flow.get('authSessions')||{};sessions[token]={id:row.id,role:row.role,teacher_id:row.teacher_id,name:row.name,email:row.email,mobile:row.mobile,expires:Date.now()+8*60*60*1000};flow.set('authSessions',sessions);msg.headers={'Set-Cookie':'dashboard_session='+token+'; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/; Max-Age=28800','Cache-Control':'no-store'};msg.payload={ok:true,message:'Login successful',user:sessions[token],session_token:token};return msg;

name: Authenticate session
func: const cookie=(msg.req&&msg.req.headers&&msg.req.headers.cookie)||'';const m=cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)dashboard_session=([^;]+)/);const authorization=(msg.req&&msg.req.headers&&msg.req.headers.authorization)||'';const bearer=authorization.match(/^Bearer\s+(.+)$/i);const sessionToken=(m&&m[1])||(bearer&&bearer[1]);let sessions=flow.get('authSessions')||{};const user=sessionToken&&sessions[sessionToken];if(!user||user.expires<Date.now()){if(sessionToken)delete sessions[sessionToken];flow.set('authSessions',sessions);msg.statusCode=401;msg.payload={error:'Authentication required'};return [null,msg];}user.expires=Date.now()+8*60*60*1000;sessions[sessionToken]=user;flow.set('authSessions',sessions);msg.auth=user;return [msg,null];

name: Return account
func: msg.headers={'Cache-Control':'no-store'};msg.payload={ok:true,user:msg.auth};return msg;

name: Destroy session
func: const cookie=(msg.req&&msg.req.headers&&msg.req.headers.cookie)||'',m=cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)dashboard_session=([^;]+)/);const authorization=(msg.req&&msg.req.headers&&msg.req.headers.authorization)||'';const bearer=authorization.match(/^Bearer\s+(.+)$/i);const sessionToken=(m&&m[1])||(bearer&&bearer[1]);let s=flow.get('authSessions')||{};if(sessionToken)delete s[sessionToken];flow.set('authSessions',s);msg.headers={'Set-Cookie':'dashboard_session=; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Path=/; Max-Age=0'};msg.payload={ok:true};return msg;

name: Authorize teacher
func: const cookie=(msg.req&&msg.req.headers&&msg.req.headers.cookie)||'';const m=cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)dashboard_session=([^;]+)/);const authorization=(msg.req&&msg.req.headers&&msg.req.headers.authorization)||'';const bearer=authorization.match(/^Bearer\s+(.+)$/i);const sessionToken=(m&&m[1])||(bearer&&bearer[1]);let sessions=flow.get('authSessions')||{};const user=sessionToken&&sessions[sessionToken];if(!user||user.expires<Date.now()){if(sessionToken)delete sessions[sessionToken];flow.set('authSessions',sessions);msg.statusCode=401;msg.payload={error:'Authentication required'};return [null,msg];}user.expires=Date.now()+8*60*60*1000;sessions[sessionToken]=user;flow.set('authSessions',sessions);msg.auth=user;if(user.role!=='teacher'||!user.teacher_id){msg.statusCode=403;msg.payload={error:'Teacher access required'};return [null,msg];}return [msg,null];

name: Build teacher session query
func: const requested=Number(msg.req&&msg.req.query&&msg.req.query.timetable_id);msg.requestedTimetableId=Number.isInteger(requested)&&requested>0?requested:0;msg.topic="SELECT tt.id AS timetable_id,tt.day_of_week,tt.period_number,TIME_FORMAT(tt.start_time,'%H:%i') AS scheduled_start,TIME_FORMAT(tt.end_time,'%H:%i') AS scheduled_end,sub.name AS subject,c.name AS section,r.room_number,ses.id AS session_id,ses.status AS session_status,st.id,st.name,st.usn,st.photo_path AS photo_url,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wave_results wc WHERE wc.session_id=ses.id AND wc.student_id=st.id) AS waves_completed,IF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM student_checkins rc WHERE rc.session_id=ses.id AND rc.student_id=st.id),1,0) AS checked_in,a.automated_status,COALESCE(a.teacher_status,a.final_status,IF(a.automated_status='present','present','absent'),'present') AS status FROM timetable tt JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id=tt.subject_id JOIN classes c ON c.id=tt.class_id JOIN rooms r ON r.id=tt.room_id JOIN students st ON st.class_id=tt.class_id AND st.active=1 LEFT JOIN attendance_sessions ses ON ses.id=(SELECT s2.id FROM attendance_sessions s2 WHERE s2.timetable_id=tt.id AND s2.session_date=CURDATE() AND s2.status IN ('active','processing','teacher_review','confirmed') ORDER BY s2.id DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.session_id=ses.id AND a.student_id=st.id WHERE tt.active=1 AND tt.teacher_id=? ORDER BY (ses.id IS NOT NULL) DESC,(tt.day_of_week=DAYNAME(CURDATE())) DESC,FIELD(tt.day_of_week,'Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday','Sunday'),tt.period_number,st.name";msg.payload=[msg.auth.teacher_id];return msg;

name: Format teacher attendance
Authorize attendance submission
func: const cookie=(msg.req&&msg.req.headers&&msg.req.headers.cookie)||'';const m=cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)dashboard_session=([^;]+)/);const authorization=(msg.req&&msg.req.headers&&msg.req.headers.authorization)||'';const bearer=authorization.match(/^Bearer\s+(.+)$/i);const sessionToken=(m&&m[1])||(bearer&&bearer[1]);let sessions=flow.get('authSessions')||{};const user=sessionToken&&sessions[sessionToken];if(!user||user.expires<Date.now()){if(sessionToken)delete sessions[sessionToken];flow.set('authSessions',sessions);msg.statusCode=401;msg.payload={error:'Authentication required'};return [null,msg];}user.expires=Date.now()+8*60*60*1000;sessions[sessionToken]=user;flow.set('authSessions',sessions);msg.auth=user;if(user.role!=='teacher'||!user.teacher_id){msg.statusCode=403;msg.payload={error:'Teacher access required'};return [null,msg];}return [msg,null];

name: Validate final statuses
func: const p=msg.payload||{},sid=Number(p.session_id),statuses=Array.isArray(p.statuses)?p.statuses:[];if(!Number.isInteger(sid)||!statuses.length){msg.statusCode=400;msg.payload={error:'Invalid attendance submission'};return [null,msg];}const clean=[];for(const x of statuses){const id=Number(x.student_id),s=String(x.status);if(!Number.isInteger(id)||!['present','absent'].includes(s)){msg.statusCode=400;msg.payload={error:'Invalid student status'};return [null,msg];}clean.push({id,status:s});}const statusCase=clean.map(x=>'WHEN '+x.id+" THEN '"+x.status+"'").join(' '),ids=clean.map(x=>x.id).join(',');msg.sessionId=sid;msg.topic="UPDATE attendance a JOIN attendance_sessions ses ON ses.id=a.session_id JOIN timetable tt ON tt.id=ses.timetable_id SET a.teacher_status=CASE a.student_id "+statusCase+" END,a.final_status=CASE a.student_id "+statusCase+" END,a.teacher_override=(a.automated_status<>CASE a.student_id "+statusCase+" END),a.confirmed_at=NOW(),a.submitted_at=NOW() WHERE a.session_id="+sid+" AND tt.teacher_id="+Number(msg.auth.teacher_id)+" AND a.student_id IN ("+ids+") AND ses.status<>'submitted'";msg.payload=[];return [msg,null];

name: Lock submitted session
func: msg.topic="UPDATE attendance_sessions SET status='submitted',end_time=COALESCE(end_time,NOW()) WHERE id=?";msg.payload=[msg.sessionId];return msg;

name: Submission success
func: msg.payload={ok:true,message:'Attendance submitted successfully'};return msg;

name: Safe API error
func: msg.statusCode=msg.statusCode||500;msg.payload={ok:false,error:(msg.error&&msg.error.message)||'ContinIo request failed'};return msg.req?[msg,null]:[null,msg];

name: SECURITY SETUP
info:
IMPORTANT: Change the admin registration code inside the “Validate registration” function node. Search for CHANGE_ME_2026 and replace it before allowing registration.

Home: http://localhost:1880/dashboard/home
Teacher: http://localhost:1880/dashboard/teacher
Admin: http://localhost:1880/dashboard/admin

Passwords are salted and hashed in continio_accounts. Sessions use HttpOnly SameSite cookies and expire after 8 hours. Login locks an IP for 15 minutes after 5 failed attempts. For deployment beyond localhost, use HTTPS and add Secure to the session cookie.

name: Create active sessions
func: msg.topic="INSERT INTO attendance_sessions (timetable_id,session_date,start_time,end_time,status) SELECT tt.id,CURDATE(),TIMESTAMP(CURDATE(),tt.start_time),TIMESTAMP(CURDATE(),tt.end_time),'active' FROM timetable tt WHERE tt.active=1 AND tt.day_of_week=DAYNAME(CURDATE()) AND tt.start_time IS NOT NULL AND tt.end_time IS NOT NULL AND CURTIME() BETWEEN tt.start_time AND tt.end_time ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE start_time=VALUES(start_time),end_time=VALUES(end_time),status=IF(status='submitted',status,'active')";msg.payload=[];return msg;

name: Prepare attendance rows
func: msg.topic="INSERT INTO attendance (session_id,student_id,automated_status) SELECT ses.id,st.id,'review' FROM attendance_sessions ses JOIN timetable tt ON tt.id=ses.timetable_id JOIN students st ON st.class_id=tt.class_id AND st.active=1 WHERE ses.session_date=CURDATE() AND ses.status='active' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE session_id=VALUES(session_id)";msg.payload=[];return msg;

name: Close elapsed sessions
func: msg.topic="UPDATE attendance_sessions ses JOIN timetable tt ON tt.id=ses.timetable_id SET ses.status='teacher_review',ses.end_time=COALESCE(ses.end_time,NOW()) WHERE ses.session_date=CURDATE() AND ses.status='active' AND CURTIME()>tt.end_time";msg.payload=[];return msg;

name: Find due verification waves
func: msg.topic="SELECT ses.id AS session_id,tt.class_id,r.room_number,r.camera_id,w.wave_number,JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id',st.id,'name',st.name,'usn',st.usn,'embedding',st.face_embedding,'checked_in',IF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM student_checkins ci WHERE ci.session_id=ses.id AND ci.student_id=st.id),TRUE,FALSE))) AS students FROM attendance_sessions ses JOIN timetable tt ON tt.id=ses.timetable_id JOIN rooms r ON r.id=tt.room_id JOIN (SELECT 1 AS wave_number,0.25 AS fraction UNION ALL SELECT 2,0.50 UNION ALL SELECT 3,0.75) w JOIN students st ON st.class_id=tt.class_id AND st.active=1 WHERE tt.active=1 AND ses.session_date=CURDATE() AND ses.status='active' AND NOW()>=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,ses.start_time,ses.end_time)*w.fraction),ses.start_time) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wave_results wr WHERE wr.session_id=ses.id AND wr.wave_number=w.wave_number) GROUP BY ses.id,tt.class_id,r.room_number,r.camera_id,w.wave_number ORDER BY ses.id,w.wave_number";msg.payload=[];return msg;

name: Build real camera scan request
func: const row=msg.payload||{};let students=row.students;if(typeof students==='string'){try{students=JSON.parse(students)}catch(e){students=[]}}if(!Array.isArray(students)||!students.length)return null;const normalized=students.map(s=>{let embedding=s.embedding;if(typeof embedding==='string'){try{embedding=JSON.parse(embedding)}catch(e){embedding=null}}return {id:Number(s.id),name:s.name,usn:s.usn,checked_in:!!s.checked_in,embedding:Array.isArray(embedding)?embedding:null}});msg.waveContext={session_id:Number(row.session_id),wave_number:Number(row.wave_number),students:normalized.map(s=>({id:s.id,name:s.name,usn:s.usn,checked_in:s.checked_in}))};msg.method='POST';msg.url='http://127.0.0.1:5055/scan';msg.headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'};msg.payload={session_id:msg.waveContext.session_id,wave_number:msg.waveContext.wave_number,class_id:Number(row.class_id),room:String(row.room_number),camera_id:row.camera_id,students:normalized};return msg;

name: Store real camera wave
func: const ctx=msg.waveContext,response=msg.payload||{};if(!ctx||!Array.isArray(response.detections)){node.error('Camera service returned an invalid response',msg);return null;}const found=new Map(response.detections.map(d=>[Number(d.student_id),Number(d.confidence)]));const rows=ctx.students.map(s=>({id:s.id,result:s.checked_in&&found.has(s.id)?'present':'absent',confidence:s.checked_in&&found.has(s.id)?found.get(s.id):null}));const placeholders=rows.map(()=>'(?,?,?,?,?)').join(',');const values=[];for(const r of rows)values.push(ctx.session_id,r.id,ctx.wave_number,r.result,r.confidence);msg.topic='INSERT INTO wave_results (session_id,student_id,wave_number,result,confidence) VALUES '+placeholders+' ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE result=VALUES(result),confidence=VALUES(confidence),detected_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP';msg.payload=values;msg.completedWave=ctx.wave_number;msg.completedSession=ctx.session_id;msg.scanMode=response.scan_mode;msg.visibleCount=response.visible_count;return msg;

name: Calculate after Wave 3
func: if(Number(msg.completedWave)!==3)return null;msg.topic="INSERT INTO attendance (session_id,student_id,automated_status,final_status) SELECT session_id,student_id,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)<3 THEN 'review' WHEN SUM(result='present')=3 THEN 'present' WHEN SUM(result='present')=2 THEN 'review' ELSE 'absent' END,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)<3 THEN NULL WHEN SUM(result='present')=3 THEN 'present' WHEN SUM(result='present')=2 THEN NULL ELSE 'absent' END FROM wave_results WHERE session_id=? GROUP BY session_id,student_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE automated_status=VALUES(automated_status),final_status=VALUES(final_status)";msg.payload=[Number(msg.completedSession)];return msg;

name: Validate check-in device
func: const key=String((msg.req&&msg.req.headers&&msg.req.headers['x-continio-key'])||'');const p=msg.payload||{};const uid=String(p.rfid_uid||'').trim();const usn=String(p.usn||'').trim().toUpperCase();const expectedKey=String(env.get('CONTINIO_DEVICE_KEY')||'');if(!expectedKey||key!==expectedKey){msg.statusCode=401;msg.payload={ok:false,error:'Invalid device key'};return [null,msg];}if((!uid&&!usn)||(uid&&usn)){msg.statusCode=400;msg.payload={ok:false,error:'Send exactly one of rfid_uid or usn'};return [null,msg];}msg.checkinMethod=uid?'rfid':'usn';msg.checkinIdentifier=uid||usn;msg.topic="SELECT ses.id AS session_id,st.id AS student_id,st.name,st.usn,c.name AS class_name,tt.period_number,sub.name AS subject,r.room_number FROM students st JOIN classes c ON c.id=st.class_id JOIN timetable tt ON tt.class_id=st.class_id AND tt.active=1 JOIN attendance_sessions ses ON ses.timetable_id=tt.id AND ses.session_date=CURDATE() AND ses.status='active' JOIN subjects sub ON sub.id=tt.subject_id JOIN rooms r ON r.id=tt.room_id WHERE ((?<>'' AND st.rfid_uid=?) OR (?<>'' AND UPPER(st.usn)=?)) AND st.active=1 AND NOW() BETWEEN ses.start_time AND ses.end_time ORDER BY ses.id DESC LIMIT 1";msg.payload=[uid,uid,usn,usn];return [msg,null];

name: Prepare student check-in
func: const row=Array.isArray(msg.payload)?msg.payload[0]:null;if(!row){msg.statusCode=404;msg.payload={ok:false,error:'No active class or matching student found'};return [null,msg];}msg.checkin=row;const isRfid=msg.checkinMethod==='rfid';msg.topic='INSERT INTO student_checkins (session_id,student_id,checkin_method,rfid_uid,entered_usn,checked_in_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE checkin_method=VALUES(checkin_method),rfid_uid=VALUES(rfid_uid),entered_usn=VALUES(entered_usn),checked_in_at=VALUES(checked_in_at)';msg.payload=[row.session_id,row.student_id,msg.checkinMethod,isRfid?msg.checkinIdentifier:null,isRfid?null:msg.checkinIdentifier];return [msg,null];

name: RFID welcome response
func: const r=msg.checkin;msg.statusCode=200;msg.payload={ok:true,message:msg.checkinMethod==='usn'?'USN check-in successful':'RFID check-in successful',checkin_method:msg.checkinMethod,session_id:r.session_id,student_id:r.student_id,name:r.name,usn:r.usn,class:r.class_name,period:r.period_number,subject:r.subject,room:r.room_number};return msg;
